_comment: Live-data signal definitions for the F10 / MSV90.
This file is intentionally EMPTY. No signal identifier, byte offset, or
scaling formula for this vehicle has been verified yet, and the project
Add an entry only when its identifier AND its decoding have been confirmed
against the real vehicle or an authoritative source, and record how in the
'source' field. An entry may be added with "verified": false while it is
still a hypothesis; the tool will then refuse to apply it unless the
operator explicitly opts in, and will label every value [UNVERIFIED].

_schema.name: machine-readable signal name (required)
_schema.identifier: data identifier as a hex string, or null if unknown
_schema.offset_bytes: byte offset of the value inside the response payload
_schema.decoder: one of the decoders in f10diag.decoding.values.DECODERS (required)
_schema.source: where this definition came from; required for verified entries
_schema.verified: true only when confirmed; defaults to false
_schema.ecu: ECU the definition applies to, e.g. DME

_example_only_not_real.name: example_temperature
_example_only_not_real.description: Illustrates the schema. Not a real F10 signal.

_planned_signals: Names only, with no identifiers or formulas, recording what we intend to
